title: Small Models, Real Systems — 11 Nov
description:
Atlassian puts a fine-tuned 4B model in front of a 20B safety model and halves moderation latency, a 400M job-posting extractor matches a 27B model but only stores salaries whose digits appear in the text, Mobile AI Factory builds fine-tuned small models per phone and shows why you score the exact quantized file, an 11 MB Russian embedder drops the transformer at serving time, and an audit finds that LLM annotators, even after fine-tuning, follow old labels more than new definitions.

Read the companion blog post (full summaries, numbers and all source links): https://swaroopgn.github.io/mylari-digest/episodes/2026-11-11/

summary: Edition 7 of the weekly small-models digest: Atlassian puts a fine-tuned 4B model in front of its 20B safety model and cuts moderation latency from 740 to 350 ms, and a 400M job-posting extractor matches a 27B model but only keeps salaries whose digits appear in the posting. Plus Mobile AI Factory on scoring the exact quantized file a phone runs, an 11 MB Russian embedder with no transformer at serving time, and an audit showing fine-tuned LLM annotators follow old labels more than new definitions.
